title: Megalithic building begins at Nan Madol
summary: Megalithic building began on artificial islets linked by canals, capital of the Saudeleur dynasty.
why: A stone city built in a lagoon; capital until about 1628.

notes.problem: Title 'built' 1180-1200 overclaims; islets began by 8th-9th c., megalithic phase began 1180-1200.
